name: browser-use
headline: Makepad Skills - Build Cross-Platform Apps
short_description: Build cross-platform apps with Makepad and AI skills. Developers use this to create applications with Rust, integrating Claude for code assistance. Connects to Makepad's design and development tools.
author: ZhangHanDong

sections.overview:
Makepad-skills provides a collection of AI-powered skills designed for building cross-platform user interfaces with Makepad 2.0. The repository includes conceptual anchors and patterns for GPU rendering, Flexbox layout, shader integration, and cross-platform design. These skills are available as Claude Code plugins, enabling developers to leverage AI assistance directly within their Makepad development workflow. The skill set covers design judgment, layout strategies, popup and overlay patterns, and troubleshooting guidance. Developers working on complex UI applications benefit from this structured knowledge base integrated with Claude's code assistance capabilities.
Rapidly develop cross-platform UI applications using Makepad.
Implement GPU-accelerated graphics for enhanced application performance.
Utilize live design features for quick iterations on UI components.
Integrate community-contributed patterns to extend application functionality.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ZhangHanDong/makepad-skills`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
